requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-5933--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-5933--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2443-2841-7892.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-7892.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

678-728-4192-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-728-4192-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

728-1339-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1339-5572.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

728-3175-4775.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

392-1170-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
392-1170-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

2232-4762-7838--177.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast the creature castable for {G} in your hand by paying its mana cost
Necklace of Girion triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Devoted Druid.
Resolve the creature spell. When the creature enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the other creature that's castable for {G} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
2232-4762-7838--177.notes: The chosen creatures that are castable for {G} cannot be artifacts, otherwise they will not trigger Cloudstone Curio. They also must be green in color (which may be relevant in cases of devoid creatures).

Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3259-5434-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-5434-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-5434-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

5016-5178-7711.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
You control a creature that has indestructible.
5016-5178-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Odric.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5016-5178-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

4613-4802-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
4613-4802-5446-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

261-3197-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-3197-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

When Hovel Hurler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

1274-4365-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4365-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

280-4826-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-4826-5451-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

478-539-3443--111.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
478-539-3443--111.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Deathbloom Ritualist.

628-2781-3305-5256.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2781-3305-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, its undying ability and Body Launderer's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Launderer.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 6, causing target player to mill cards equal to Felidar Guardian's power.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger from step 5, blinking Body Launderer.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Felidar Guardian's power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its undying and second ability triggers.
Resolve the undying trigger,  returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Body Launderer trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any other permanent you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 11, causing target player to mill cards equal to Body Launderer's power.
Repeat.

Freed from the Real attached to Avid Reclaimer.

175-3162-4222.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

659-2645-4050.easyPrerequisites: Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
659-2645-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
659-2645-4050.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Goblin tokens, adding {4}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Iridescent Drake, adding {C}{C}.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Abduction triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Repeat.

215-2469-2661-2713.notablePrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
215-2469-2661-2713.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Phyrexian Dreadnought enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Phyrexian Dreadnought ability, failing to sacrifice it due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
